known_issues.probable_cause: Gen1 fans have sleeve bearings that wear out in humid coastal conditions

known_issues.issue: Water ingress in cabinet during monsoon
known_issues.probable_cause: Degraded door gasket and cable gland seals
RFID reader cable loose; QR camera lens fogging

incident_history.symptoms: Slots 3 and 4 derating, fan fault alarm on charger modules CM-03 and CM-04
incident_history.resolution: Replaced both fans with Gen2 ball-bearing fans (part FAN-80-BB). Recommended fleet-wide fan upgrade for Gen1 stations

incident_history.symptoms: Moisture sensor alarm, RCCB tripped, water droplets found near busbar
incident_history.root_cause: Door gasket cracked; rain water entered during heavy downpour
incident_history.resolution: Station isolated, cabinet dried with heat blower, insulation resistance tested (>50 MΩ), gasket replaced, silica gel packs added, station restored

incident_history.symptoms: Multiple riders reported 'Authentication failed' on QR scan
incident_history.root_cause: QR camera lens fogged due to humidity
incident_history.resolution: Cleaned lens, applied anti-fog coating, enabled RFID fallback for fleet riders

incident_history.symptoms: Battery INSMOMAH1209C176F813 triggered over-temperature alarm in slot 9 during charging
incident_history.root_cause: Battery internal fault (cell 11 abnormal temperature rise) - not a station fault
incident_history.resolution: Charging stopped automatically, slot 9 locked, battery moved to quarantine bin, slot 9 inspected and cleared. Battery sent for RMA
